trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Complete every other trophy in the list; the platinum unlocks automatically after the remaining 54 are earned. Treat this as the final confirmation rather than a separate task, and it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and carry it through to its completion screen. This is part of the main path and cannot be missed while finishing the story.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every required mission in Chapter 1 until the chapter-complete award appears. It is story-bound and cannot be missed on a completed campaign.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every required mission in Chapter 2 and advance past its closing sequence. It is story-bound and cannot be missed on a completed campaign.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every required mission in Chapter 3 and advance into the next chapter. It is story-bound and cannot be missed on a completed campaign.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every required mission in Chapter 4 and let the chapter completion register. It is story-bound and cannot be missed on a completed campaign.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the campaign’s final mission after clearing any unfinished free-roam work you want to do first. The trophy itself is story-bound, but this mission is the roadmap’s point of no return for the cleanest one-playthrough route.

trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus; use the in-game trophy tracker or activity record to confirm the requirement has registered. Work on it during free roam or post-story cleanup, and make a manual save before the relevant encounter because the opportunity can be missed.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: During the VCIA sequence, trigger the special unscheduled departure implied by the description rather than taking the normal exit. Make a manual save before the mission or sequence because this situational action can be missed.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Use a Rhino during the relevant high-heat opportunity and satisfy the hidden condition before the encounter ends. Keep a manual save before attempting it because the official clue is situational and the opportunity can be missed.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Enter and finish a jewelry-store robbery without alerting guards or triggering detection. Restart immediately if detected and keep a pre-robbery save; the clean run condition makes this missable within an attempt.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape; use the in-game trophy tracker or activity record to confirm the requirement has registered. Work on it during free roam or post-story cleanup, and it is not missable.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: At Ocean Beach, use the cocktail interaction at a viewpoint that satisfies the hidden clue. Do this before the final mission and keep a manual save, since the required contextual moment can be passed over.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: During the vehicle-showroom opportunity, escape by smashing a vehicle through the showroom in the manner implied by the clue. Save beforehand and replay immediately if the action does not register because it is encounter-specific.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: At the Kolt & Associates bowling alley, perform the required follow-through during the relevant bowling opportunity. Make a save before playing and confirm the trophy before moving on because the hidden condition is easy to overlook.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: During the partnership sequence tied to a large audience, complete the hidden contextual action before the scene ends. Preserve a manual save beforehand because the official description points to a one-scene opportunity.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make the required choices across the campaign and allow each to register toward this hidden condition. Keep rotating chapter saves and finish this before the point of no return, as choices cannot always be revised afterward.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: When the relevant failed attempt occurs, return and succeed on the second try as the clue specifies. Keep a save before the sequence and avoid skipping the retry, because later success may not reproduce the exact condition.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Stay with the unusual encounter until its final event completes and the trophy registers. Save before investigating and finish it before the finale because the hidden scene may be a one-time opportunity.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: From a moving vehicle, use a melee strike to knock a target down and satisfy the drive-by condition. Attempt it in free roam with a clean save and confirm it registers; the action is repeatable but easy to pass over.
